tess (finance): Quick heads-up: we'll launch an invoice layout and credit policy update on 2026-08-01. Short thread with what teams need to do.

omar (revops): Summary: 1) 'Free credits applied' will be shown as its own pre-tax line item. 2) Free trial window for new signups moves from 90d -> 60d (existing trials grandfathered for 30 days after rollout). 3) Micro-overage smoothing: overages < $12 auto-credit next invoice, once per billing cycle. No price changes.

lee (product): Will this change any API responses?

omar (revops): No breaking API changes. Webhook v2 will include `free_credits_applied` and `micro_overage_credit` fields. Docs updated.

zoe (cs): CS needs a one-pager and canned responses for customers asking about trial length.

tess (finance): Draft FAQ and email uploaded: <https://internal.redwood/comm/billing/aug-2026-draft>. Please review.

billing-bot: Billing webhook spec v2 pushed to staging (auto).

lee (product): On invoicing: example snippet we'll show customers:
``
Usage: $145.00
Free credits applied: -$50.00
Micro overage credit: -$9.00
Tax: $7.20
Total due: $93.20
```

omar (revops): Ops note: micro-overage credits not applied if account has an open dispute or is delinquent. Data export will include new columns for reconciliation.

zoe (cs): Thanks. We'll review FAQ and reply by EOD Fri. Please :thumbsup: when reviewed.

tess (finance): :thumbsup:
